<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. Pre-overdraw Flow balances hold only up to T + N (requires Goes ≤ T + N, FromNothing giving, Needing); Flow.never_returns_below_within requires initial below : W.level T c < m; Coupled.Indexed correspondence requires all needs met and constant draw across rules.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Overdrawing steps where x < taken (Nat subtraction truncates, so Flow conservation breaks at failure rather than being salvaged by min-clamping).
- Absorption of LineOnAStock.way_ends / WayUnderARule.tested_or_ends by Flow.family_excess_ends or Stage 2 deletion of ends_all.
